body.x: OptAI Inc. (CEO Jaeho Lee) participated in CES 2026 Unveiled, held on January 4 (local time) in Las Vegas, the United States.

OptAI is a deep-tech startup that provides hardware-aware AI optimization technologies to industries where real-time processing, low power consumption, and data integrity are essential, including automotive, robotics, and mobile. By leveraging Korea’s competitiveness as a manufacturing powerhouse, the company aims to lead the global adoption of differentiated on-device AI technologies.

OptAI has previously validated its technical reliability and commercialization potential through collaborations with global companies and plans to expand its business around model-optimization technologies based on hardware characteristics. At CES Unveiled, the company actively promoted not only its core technologies but also the references it has accumulated in Korea to global media outlets.

OptHancer, the solution exhibited by OptAI, is an end-to-end on-device optimization platform designed to resolve performance bottlenecks that arise when running high-performance AI models on low-spec, low-power devices. Unlike general-purpose automated toolkits that treat hardware characteristics as a secondary consideration, OptHancer adopts a hardware-first strategy that begins with analysis of the target silicon.

At the core of the platform is OptAI’s “Surgical Model Re-Architecture.” This approach uses AI-agent-based hardware analysis to identify processor architectures and computational characteristics automatically, then reconstructs AI models in a hardware-friendly manner by combining techniques such as quantization, pruning, and knowledge distillation.

According to the company, OptAI minimizes the accuracy loss that often occurs during optimization while ensuring consistent inference speed and stability on actual devices. In addition, the platform provides heterogeneous processor scheduling technologies and an equivalence verification system to guarantee performance reliability even after model lightweighting.

body.cap: Junyoung Seo, COO of OptAI, is interviewed by AVING News reporter Jay Kennedy Markus at CES 2026 Unveiled. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Based on these technologies, OptAI has secured optimization references across various environments, including mobile NPUs and automotive system-on-chips (SoCs), and has accumulated technological maturity through experience building on-device large language models (LLMs) and multiple patents and academic papers. As a result, OptHancer was selected as a CES 2026 Innovation Award honoree, earning recognition for its achievements on the international stage.

OptAI plans to establish California in the United States as its first base for global expansion, targeting markets with strong demand for high-performance AI adoption, such as mobile, robotics, and autonomous driving. The company also aims to enter Germany and Japan in succession, supplying hardware-aware optimization technologies to manufacturing, automotive, and precision robotics industries.

An OptAI official said, “CES and Unveiled this year served as the ideal stage to confirm global market demand for on-device AI optimization technologies. Based on the networks and insights gained here, we plan to pursue collaboration with global companies,” adding, “We aim to grow into a company that sets the standard for on-device AI in the global market by preparing customized strategies suited to the hardware environments of each country.”

body.cap: OptAI team members, including COO Junyoung Seo, introduce their OptHancer platform to foreign media journalists at CES 2026 Unveiled. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Meanwhile, the company will also participate in the leading CES 2026 exhibition, held from January 6 to 9, as part of the Seoul Pavilion located in Eureka Park, the startup-dedicated exhibition zone. The CES 2026 Seoul Pavilion, led by the Seoul Business Agency (SBA), brings together 19 startup support organizations in Seoul, including district offices, related institutions, and universities, to support 70 startups. The participating companies span advanced technology fields such as AI, mobility, and healthcare, and selected outstanding firms receive opportunities to participate in the official CES media event, CES Unveiled.

‘CES Unveiled’ is a key official event held ahead of the CES opening, bringing together Innovation Award winners and companies showcasing innovative, cutting-edge products. The event brings together global media, company executives, government officials, and significant technology industry stakeholders in one place.
